text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer.
I look forward to your guidance again today.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Were you able to get some good rest over the break?
Yeah. Did you get some good rest over the break?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Rest is also part of training.
I made sure to take it easy—cooking at my own pace,
going for strolls, and relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I was able to thoroughly
rest my mind and body.
I will tackle this with full focus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To ensure effective training,
she managed herself well over the break
and seems to have come back fully refreshed.
